title: Strike the Shepherd and the Sheep Will Scatter
coreMove: Target the coordinating center rather than wrestling every follower separately
sourcePressure: Chapter 42 centers on the leverage created when power is concentrated in a central figure. The law argues that groups, institutions, or conflicts often weaken faster when the source of coordination, charisma, or command is directly targeted. Its limit is that root-cause focus should not become indiscriminate cruelty, scapegoating, or blindness to systems that survive beyond one visible leader. Frozen sidecar provides no traceable named anecdote for this chapter; do not fabricate named source anchors.
